key_insight: Structural functional identifiability analysis can determine whether unknown observation maps and mechanistic model parameters can be uniquely learned from data.
engineering_relevance: This helps assess whether hybrid differential equation models recover meaningful sensor-to-state relationships rather than merely fit observed outputs.
method: Represent unknown observation maps with neural networks while retaining mechanistic dynamics.
Use differential algebra to assess identifiability of observation maps and core parameters.
Prove general conditions for identifiability and non-identifiability.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical results and a general analysis methodology, but provides no dataset details or quantitative evaluation metrics.
watch_item: Structural identifiability does not guarantee reliable recovery from finite, noisy data or successful neural network training.
paper_title: Structural functional identifiability of unknown differential equation observation maps
